name: thinking-block-streaming
notes: The transcript's THINKING/REASONING row, a distinct render path from ordinary assistant content: it is prefixed with a marker glyph, truncated with an ellipsis mid-word, and gated on app.show_reasoning. stream-multi-chunk.json emits two Reasoning events so the row carries concatenated text, which is the case that truncation has to get right. messages == 1 pins the flush: the two Reasoning events and the three Content events must coalesce into exactly ONE transcript message, so a regression that emitted one row per stream chunk changes the count and fails here as well as in the text baseline.
